name: COVID-19 Vaccination Coverage, Citywide
rowLabel: COVID-19 coverage metric for a subpopulation by week

Metadata.Time Period: September 13, 2023 through the most recent date shown

columns.name: Week End
columns.description: End date of the week. Dates are based on standard MMWR weeks as defined by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

columns.name: Season
columns.description: Annually recurring reporting period for which estimates are calculated.

columns.name: Race/Ethnicity
columns.description: Values used are: Latinx; Black, non-Latinx; White, non-Latinx; Asian, non-Latinx; Other, non-Latinx; Unknown; All Race/Ethnicities

columns.name: Sex
columns.description: Values used are: Male, Female, Unknown, All Sexes

columns.name: Population Size
columns.description: Number of people in the group based on the specified combination of the age, race/ethnicity, and sex.

columns.name: Count
columns.description: Number of people in the specified group that achieved the vaccination status.

columns.name: Percent
columns.description: Percent of people in the specified group that achieved the vaccination status.

columns.name: MMWR Week
columns.description: A weekly counting system within a calendar year standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

columns.name: Week
columns.description: The calendar week standardized by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

columns.name: Current Season Week End
columns.description: Ending date of the MMWR week for the current season
